productName: Addison Crib with Raised Panel Headboard
description:
Make a bold, beautiful statement in the nursery with the Addison Crib featuring a raised panel headboard. This 4-in-1 convertible crib offers the same solid hardwood construction and Brown Maple finish as the classic Addison, elevated by a raised panel design that adds architectural depth and sophistication to your little one's room.

Transition seamlessly from crib to toddler bed, daybed, and full-size (double) bed as your child grows, a single investment that serves your family for years. Three adjustable mattress height settings provide flexibility and safety from newborn to toddler. Finished with non-toxic, baby-safe materials and rigorously tested to exceed CPSC and ASTM standards, this crib gives you style without compromise.

Pair with the full Addison collection for a coordinated look that flows beautifully from nursery to big-kid room.

If you would like help choosing a finish, confirming timing, or picturing how this piece fits your nursery plans, use Get Personal Assistance. We reply the same or next business day so you can decide with full information, at your own pace.
